{{Top|leg}}
'''Dinbar''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]]. It was located on Elrood's largest continent on the western edge of the [[Lodon Ocean]]. The city boasted an Imperial-class [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]]. The city headquartered [[Transsector Lines Ltd.]]
